caption: The LFSR feeds vectors to the circuit, the MISR squeezes every response into one signature, and a single comparator turns the whole run into one pass or fail bit.

spec.title: Logic BIST loop
spec.aria: On-chip BIST loop in which an LFSR generates vectors, the MISR compresses the responses into a signature, and a comparator against the golden signature gives a single pass or fail bit.
